strings.cli.help:
Cyberpunk Mod Translator - command line

  cmt analyze   <mod>
      Shows the texts found in the mod and what will be translated.
  cmt export    <mod> <file.tsv> [--from <existing translation>] [--all]
      Writes the lines to a TSV file (fill in the "translation" column).
      Status: "to translate", "to check" (maybe text), "already translated".
      --all also writes the strings classed as "code" (identifiers, paths...).
  cmt build     <mod> <file.tsv> <output folder>
  cmt build     <mod> --from <existing translation> <output folder>
      Builds the "#<archive>_<LANG>.archive" patch and a zip to install in MO2.
  cmt list      <file.archive>
      Lists what an archive contains.

<mod> = the mod's folder (for example in MO2\mods) or the .zip downloaded from Nexus.
Options: --game <Cyberpunk 2077 folder>   --lang fr-fr   --no-compression   --ui en|fr|...   --debug
The French names also work: analyser, exporter, construire, lister, --jeu, --langue, --depuis, --tout, --sans-compression.
Log: {0}
